buildCommand: if [ "$ENABLE_CONVEX_CLOUD" = "false" ]; then echo "ENABLE_CONVEX_CLOUD=false — refusing to deploy a new Convex preview backend" && exit 1; fi && npx convex deploy && npx convex deploy --cmd 'curl -fsS -X POST "${VITE_CONVEX_URL/.convex.cloud/.convex.site}/seed" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SEED_SECRET" && npm run build'
